# DIA Launches xReal: The First Oracle Suite Designed for Real-World Asset (RWA) Applications
**DIA introduces the first oracle suite designed for Real-World Asset (RWA) applications on-chain. Explore now over 100+ price feeds for RWAs!**
**By Mikel Garcia (Core-Team)** | **February 19, 2025** | **3 minutes read**
![DIA Launches xReal: The First Oracle Suite Designed for Real-World Asset (RWA) Applications](https://cms3.diadata.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/cover-of-DIA-xREAL-announcement-oracles-for-RWAs-700x365.jpg)
## Bridging TradFi and DeFi With the RWA Oracles
In a major leap forward for the tokenized economy, **DIA is unveiling xReal**, the first comprehensive oracle suite tailored specifically for **Real-World Asset (RWA) applications on-chain**. This launch marks a pivotal step in the evolution of DeFi infrastructure, offering a powerful bridge between **traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi)**—a sector that is rapidly gaining traction with **$17.4 billion in tokenized RWAs on-chain** and forecasted to **exceed $10 trillion by 2030**, according to Coindesk.[[1]](https://app.rwa.xyz/) [[2]](https://www.coindesk.com/opinion/2025/02/07/rwa-tokenization-is-going-to-trillions-much-faster-than-you-think)
With xReal, **DIA cements its position as the go-to oracle provider for RWA applications** across all major blockchain ecosystems. The suite comprises **two core offerings**:
- **xReal Price Feeds** – Secure, transparent, and on-chain price oracles for RWA-powered dApps such as **options, futures, prediction markets, and tokenized index funds**. These feeds support **100+ real-world assets at launch**, spanning **stocks, commodities, ETFs, FX rates, and more**—with continuous expansion. - **xReal Custom Solutions** – A tailor-made oracle service for developers looking to **bring custom off-chain financial data on-chain**. This enables applications to integrate **real-world financial metrics** such as **physical reserves, bonds, inflation rates, and federal rates**, unlocking a new realm of possibilities for DeFi innovation.
![DIA xReal oracle products for Real-World Assets (RWAs)](https://cms3.diadata.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/products-700x450.png)
*DIA xReal oracle products for Real-World Assets (RWAs)*
## RWA: The Next Big Wave in DeFi Innovation
Tokenization of real-world assets is quickly emerging as the **most promising growth sector in DeFi**. **From stablecoins backed by treasuries to tokenized bonds and equities, on-chain RWAs represent the next frontier of blockchain adoption**. DIA is already a key player in this ecosystem, providing oracle services to leading RWA projects such as:
- **Strategic partnerships with [Ripple](https://www.diadata.org/blog/post/dia-brings-price-oracles-to-xrpl/) & [Stellar](https://www.diadata.org/blog/post/soroban-stellar-oracle-dia/)**—both blockchains heavily focused on enabling RWA tokenization at scale - [[Fermion](https://www.diadata.org/blog/post/dia-fermion-revolutionize-rwa-fractionalization/)** – tokenization of real-world assets** - [[Denario](https://www.diadata.org/blog/post/dia-partners-with-denario-to-deploy-rwa-oracle-for-tokenized-silver/)** – precious metals on-chain** - **Azos** – CDP protocol using RWA collateral - [[Davos](https://www.diadata.org/blog/post/partnership-with-davos/)** – RWA Lending and Borrowing** - [[USDV](https://www.diadata.org/blog/post/partnership-with-verified-usd-usdv/)** – tokenized RWA backed stablecoin**
With **xReal v1.0**, DIA sets the foundation for a **robust and scalable Oracle** **infrastructure for RWAs**. Meanwhile, **xReal v2.0 is** **already in development. ** It will integrate [[DIA](https://www.diadata.org/lumina/) Lumina**'s Zero-Knowledge Proof technology** to provide **trustless verifiability** for off-chain data, **pushing the security and reliability of RWAs** **to the next level**.
![Data types of DIA xReal, Oracles for RWAs](https://cms3.diadata.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/Screenshot-2025-02-19-at-11.28.47-700x360.jpg)
*xReal covers a variety of RWA classes, spanning from stocks, ETFs to FX rates.*
## Powering a New Wave of On-Chain RWA Applications
With xReal, developers can **eliminate the need for centralized brokerages** and empower users with **on-chain access to real-world financial assets**. Some of the **key use cases unlocked by xReal include**:
- **RWA-Backed Stablecoins** – Launch stablecoins **pegged to fiat, T-bills, or bonds** with transparent, on-chain verification. - **Tokenized Stock Trading** – Enable users to **buy and sell tokenized equities on DEXs**, removing barriers to traditional stock markets. - **Bond Derivatives** – Facilitate **on-chain hedging and speculation** on bond market movements - **On-Chain Index Funds** – Allow investors to **track major stock indices** with a single tokenized asset.
## Explore xReal – The Future of RWA Oracles
A dedicated **xReal page is now live on the DIA App**, allowing users and developers to explore **all available data feeds** and begin integrating **the next era of RWA-powered dApps**.
**The future of finance is on-chain. Welcome to xReal.**
